wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.role: one host-owned line on every approval card raised in a conversation that holds Team Bridge content
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.tone: plain, cautionary, operator-facing; keep the em dash
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.note: Team Bridge is a product name: never translate it. Rendered on TUI, desktop (via the pending description) and the y/N terminal prompt.

wire.bridge_taint.grant_suspended.role: one-time transcript notice when a session-scoped auto approval stops covering calls because Team Bridge content arrived
wire.bridge_taint.grant_suspended.note: Keep `/approvals auto` verbatim: it is a command. Team Bridge is a product name.

wire.bridge_taint.ack_refused.role: receipt detail when an 'approvals auto' command from an approval card is refused in a conversation holding Team Bridge content
wire.bridge_taint.ack_refused.note: Keep `/approvals` verbatim: it is a command. Team Bridge is a product name.
